The abstract describes an LLM workflow with hierarchical document-enhanced retrieval, where retrieved text from datasheets is used by the LLM for parameter extraction. This is a retrieval-conditioned generation system. It contrasts itself with "traditional RAG systems" but is effectively a RAG variant. It also reports experiments against baselines, so it should be included.
